anchorEmpty: No usable trust anchors. Create one first.
anchorHelp: The CA the device certificates must chain to. A device earmarked for this profile takes its token from the certificate's common name: {{prefix}} followed by the CN, which is the device's external id.
authHelp_CERTIFICATE: Devices register with a client certificate whose chain reaches a trust anchor. There is no secret to issue or rotate.
authHelp_SECRET: Devices register with the provision key and a secret the server generates and shows once.
deleteConfirm: Delete provisioning profile “{{token}}”? This cannot be undone. A profile that has registered devices cannot be deleted until its devices are revoked and reset.
earmarkDerivedHint: This is a certificate profile: the device's token is derived from its certificate's common name as {{prefix}} followed by the CN. Set the external id to the CN and leave the token empty, or set it to that value.
earmarkEmpty: No provisioning profiles for this device type.
earmarkHelp: Optional. Only this profile can adopt the device when it registers itself.
enabledHelp: Turn off to refuse new registrations at once.
expiresHelp: After this time the profile refuses new registrations. Devices already registered are unaffected. Leave empty for never.
keyHelp: The public name devices register under, unique within the tenant. It is stored exactly as typed. The secret is generated for you.
listDescription: The shared key and secret a fleet registers itself with, and the rules for which devices it may register
listEmpty: No provisioning profiles yet. Create one to let a fleet register itself instead of creating each device by hand.
maxDevicesHelp: The most devices this profile may register. Leave empty for no limit. Lowering it only refuses further registrations.
maxDevicesInvalid: Use a whole number of at least 1, or leave it empty for no limit.
revealCopyManually: Could not copy automatically. The field is selected; copy it by hand.
revealCreatedBody: “{{token}}” was created. Give devices this key and secret to register with.
revealRotatedBody: The secret of “{{token}}” was replaced. The previous secret no longer works.
revealRotatedTitle: Copy the new provision secret now
revealShownOnce: You won't see this secret again. The platform keeps only a one-way digest, so it cannot be shown later. If you lose it, rotate the secret.
revokeConfirm: Disable the credentials of up to {{count}} device(s) registered through “{{token}}” and end their live connections? They are refused until you reset each one's provisioning. The profile keeps accepting new registrations; rotate its secret as well if the secret may have leaked.
rotateConfirm: Replace the secret of “{{token}}”? The current secret stops working immediately, with no overlap: any device or script still holding it is refused until it is given the new one. The {{count}} device(s) already registered keep their credentials and are not affected. The new secret is shown once.
rotateNoSecret: This profile has no secret to rotate.
rotateRequiredHint: This profile has no server-generated secret yet, so it refuses every registration until you rotate its secret.
rotateRequiredNotice: This profile's secret was chosen before the platform generated secrets, so the registration endpoint refuses every device. Rotate the secret to bring it into service.
strategyHelp_ALLOW_NEW: A device that has not been created yet is created when it registers. A device you created and expected for this profile is adopted. A device that was not expected for this profile is never taken over.
strategyHelp_CHECK_PRE_PROVISIONED: Only devices you created beforehand and expected for this profile can register. An unknown device is refused.
summaryNote: Registered devices hold a credential this profile issued, revoked ones included. Expected devices were created for this profile and have not necessarily registered yet.
summaryNoteCertificate: Devices authenticate with a certificate chaining to the trust anchor, so there is no secret. A device earmarked for this profile takes its token from its certificate: {{prefix}} followed by the common name (its external id).
title: Provisioning profiles
tokenFixed: The profile id; it cannot change.
typeHelp: The type of every device this profile creates, and the only type it will adopt.
